lines.text: Checkpoint A. Let's review Phases 1 to 3, with extra care on leverage and safety.
lines.say: Checkpoint A. Let's review Phases one to three, with extra care on leverage and safety.

lines.text: Eight questions on lessons T01 to T13. Most are about risk, because that matters most.
lines.say: Eight questions on lessons T one to T thirteen. Most are about risk, because that matters most.

lines.text: Read each question, pick an answer, and pause the video whenever you need more time.
lines.say: Read each question, pick an answer, and pause the video whenever you need more time.

lines.text: It's not graded. Missing one just shows you what to revisit.
lines.say: It's not graded. Missing one just shows you what to revisit.

lines.text: Question one, from T04. 'Support' asks for your 2FA code and API secret key. What do you do?
lines.say: Question one, from T four. 'Support' asks for your two-factor code and A-P-I secret key. What do you do?

lines.text: C. Never share them. Open the official app yourself and contact support from there.
lines.say: C. Never share them. Open the official app yourself and contact support from there.

lines.text: B is tempting, but an API secret key can control your account too. Share neither.
lines.say: B is tempting, but an A-P-I secret key can control your account too. Share neither.

lines.text: Question two, from T05 and T11. What is the key difference between spot and futures?
lines.say: Question two, from T five and T eleven. What is the key difference between spot and futures?

lines.text: A. On spot you own the coin. Futures are contracts about its price.
lines.say: A. On spot you own the coin. Futures are contracts about its price.

lines.text: Not B: futures aren't cheap coins. They use margin, pay funding and can be liquidated.
lines.say: Not B: futures aren't cheap coins. They use margin, pay funding and can be liquidated.

lines.text: Question three, from T06 and T09. Gross +4 USDT. Fees: 3 to enter, 3 to exit. What's the net?
lines.say: Question three, from T six and T nine. Gross plus four U-S-D-T. Fees: three to enter, three to exit. What's the net?

lines.text: C, minus 2 USDT. Net is gross minus all fees: 4 minus 3 minus 3.
lines.say: C, minus two U-S-D-T. Net is gross minus all fees: four minus three minus three.

lines.text: B is only the gross result. Fees are paid whether the trade wins or loses.
lines.say: B is only the gross result. Fees are paid whether the trade wins or loses.

lines.text: Question four, from T07 and T08. Your stop is at 59,000. Price gaps from 59,300 to 58,600.
lines.say: Question four, from T seven and T eight. Your stop is at fifty-nine thousand. Price gaps from fifty-nine thousand three hundred to fifty-eight thousand six hundred.

lines.text: B. Near 58,600, or even worse. A stop is a trigger, not a price guarantee.
lines.say: B. Near fifty-eight thousand six hundred, or even worse. A stop is a trigger, not a price guarantee.

lines.text: A is the trap. In fast markets, no stop can promise its exact price.
lines.say: A is the trap. In fast markets, no stop can promise its exact price.

lines.text: Question five, from T12. 100 USDT of margin at 10x, long. BTC falls 2%. What's the gross PnL?
lines.say: Question five, from T twelve. One hundred U-S-D-T of margin at ten ex, long. B-T-C falls two percent. What's the gross P and L?

lines.text: B, minus 20 USDT. Notional is 1,000, and 1,000 times minus 2% is minus 20.
lines.say: B, minus twenty U-S-D-T. Notional is one thousand, and one thousand times minus two percent is minus twenty.

lines.text: A forgets the leverage. The move acts on the whole 1,000: that's 20% of your margin.
lines.say: A forgets the leverage. The move acts on the whole one thousand: that's twenty percent of your margin.

lines.text: Question six, from T12. Which statement about leverage is true?
lines.say: Question six, from T twelve. Which statement about leverage is true?

lines.text: B. Leverage magnifies gains and losses alike, compared with your margin.
lines.say: B. Leverage magnifies gains and losses alike, compared with your margin.

lines.text: A is a myth. No leverage number is safe. Lower leverage only means smaller swings.
lines.say: A is a myth. No leverage number is safe. Lower leverage only means smaller swings.

lines.text: Question seven, from T13. Can a stop-loss guarantee you won't be liquidated?
lines.say: Question seven, from T thirteen. Can a stop-loss guarantee you won't be liquidated?

lines.text: B. No. Stops can slip, and with high leverage, liquidation can come first.
lines.say: B. No. Stops can slip, and with high leverage, liquidation can come first.

lines.text: A is the dangerous one. A stop-loss is not liquidation insurance.
lines.say: A is the dangerous one. A stop-loss is not liquidation insurance.

lines.text: Question eight, from T13. A long with 2,000 USDT notional. Funding rate +0.01%. What happens?
lines.say: Question eight, from T thirteen. A long with two thousand U-S-D-T notional. Funding rate plus zero point zero one percent. What happens?

lines.text: A. You pay 0.20 USDT: 2,000 times 0.01%. A positive rate means longs pay shorts.
lines.say: A. You pay zero point two U-S-D-T: two thousand times zero point zero one percent. A positive rate means longs pay shorts.

lines.text: B has it backwards. Shorts pay longs only when the rate is negative.
lines.say: B has it backwards. Shorts pay longs only when the rate is negative.

lines.text: Before Phase 4, the critical safety points.
lines.say: Before Phase four, the critical safety points.

lines.text: Leverage magnifies losses. No leverage is safe, and liquidation can take your margin.
lines.say: Leverage magnifies losses. No leverage is safe, and liquidation can take your margin.

lines.text: A stop-loss is not liquidation insurance. Gaps and slippage happen.
lines.say: A stop-loss is not liquidation insurance. Gaps and slippage happen.

lines.text: Never share passwords, OTP or 2FA codes, or API secret keys. Not even with 'support'.
lines.say: Never share passwords, O-T-P or two-factor codes, or A-P-I secret keys. Not even with 'support'.

lines.text: You can always choose WAIT, or no trade. And in this course, everything is demo only.
lines.say: You can always choose wait, or no trade. And in this course, everything is demo only.

lines.text: Here's where to look if you missed one.
lines.say: Here's where to look if you missed one.

lines.text: Question one: T04. Two: T05 and T11. Three: T06 and T09. Four: T07 and T08.
lines.say: Question one: T four. Two: T five and T eleven. Three: T six and T nine. Four: T seven and T eight.

lines.text: Five and six: T12. Seven and eight: T13.
lines.say: Five and six: T twelve. Seven and eight: T thirteen.

lines.text: Rewatch any lesson, no penalty. Leverage and liquidation deserve a second look.
lines.say: Rewatch any lesson, no penalty. Leverage and liquidation deserve a second look.

lines.text: Phase 4 starts next, with T14: candlesticks. Open, high, low and close. See you there!
lines.say: Phase four starts next, with T fourteen: candlesticks. Open, high, low and close. See you there!
